h1: Roof Coating Services in McAllen, TX
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction applies reflective coatings to flat and low slope commercial roofs in McAllen. We inspect first and tell you plainly whether your roof is a good candidate.

sections.title: What a coating does on a McAllen roof
paras: A roof coating is a liquid layer rolled or sprayed over an existing flat or low slope roof. It cures into one continuous reflective layer. On a roof that is aging but still sound, it seals small cracks and seams, reflects sunlight, and adds years before the roof needs a full replacement.

McAllen is a good place for that kind of product because of the heat. NOAA normals for the McAllen airport show about 40 days a year at 100°F or hotter, and the average high in August is 99.6°F. A dark membrane in that sun runs much hotter than the air, and that heat is what dries it out and opens seams. A reflective surface keeps the roof cooler, which slows that wear and can lower the heat load on the building below.

sections.title: When a coating is the wrong call
paras: A coating is not a fix for a failed roof. If water has already soaked the insulation under the membrane, coating over it traps the moisture, and the roof keeps rotting underneath. If the membrane is split, blistered across large areas, or pulling loose from the deck, it needs repair or replacement first.

That is why we inspect before we quote. We walk the whole roof, check the seams and flashing, and look for wet areas. If the roof qualifies, we give you a written estimate for the coating. If it does not, we tell you and explain what it needs instead. See commercial roofing in McAllen for repair and replacement.

sections.title: Signs your McAllen roof may be a coating candidate

cards.title: Aging, not failing
cards.body: The membrane is chalky, faded, or has small surface cracks, but it is still attached and dry underneath.

cards.title: Seams starting to open
cards.body: Seams and flashing show early wear that can be sealed and reinforced before the coat goes on.

cards.title: Hot top floor
cards.body: The space under the roof runs hot in summer. A reflective surface reduces the heat coming through.

cards.title: Replacement is years away
cards.body: You want more service life from the roof you have before spending on a full tear off.

sections.title: After a McAllen hailstorm
paras: Hail is hard on any flat roof, coated or not. During the May 8, 2025 storm, spotters reported hail up to 2 inches in north McAllen. Hail that size can crack a coating and bruise the membrane under it. If your coated roof was in the path of that storm, have it checked. Small hail marks can be cleaned and recoated; punctures need a repair first.

faqs.q: Will a coating stop my roof from leaking?
faqs.a: Only if the leak comes from small surface wear that the coating seals. Most active leaks need to be found and repaired first. We fix the leak, then coat if the roof qualifies.

faqs.q: How long does a roof coating last?
faqs.a: It depends on the product, the thickness applied, and the roof underneath. A coating can add several years of service life. You get a realistic estimate for your roof, not a generic number.

faqs.q: Is a coating cheaper than replacing the roof?
faqs.a: Yes, when the roof qualifies. A coating costs a fraction of a tear off and new roof, so it is worth checking first on a roof that is old but still dry.

faqs.q: Can you coat a shingle roof on my house?
faqs.a: Coatings are for flat and low slope roofs. Most McAllen homes have pitched shingle roofs, where a coating is not the right fit. For a house, see roof repair or roof replacement in McAllen.

faqs.q: Do you need to be on the roof before giving a price?
faqs.a: Yes. A coating price depends on the roof's size, its condition, and how much prep it needs, and none of that shows from the parking lot.

faqs.q: How do I get a coating estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. The inspection and estimate are free.
